children: W&T Offshore amended its Credit Agreement to convert its revolving line into a reserve-based revolving credit facility with a $100 million maximum and $50 million in initial elected commitments. The initial borrowing base is $50 million, with semi-annual redeterminations starting Nov. 1, 2026. Key economics, including interest rate margins and a 3.00% SOFR floor, are unchanged; the restricted payments cap rises to $15 million and new borrowings are conditioned on cash not exceeding the greater of $10 million or 10% of the borrowing base. Macquarie exited as a lender and Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce joined with a $10 million commitment.
: Reserve-based revolving credit facility amendment ($100 million max, $50 million commitments)
: Texas Capital Bank and other lenders
: Until Jul 28 2028 or 6 months before Senior Second Lien Notes maturity
: Enhance liquidity with reserve-based borrowing structure
